summary.en: Octapharma develops plasma-derived and recombinant protein therapies across hematology, immunotherapy and critical care. Reviewed disclosures emphasize existing-product development; no asset meeting the brief’s inclusion rules was verified.
summary.zh: Octapharma 开发血液学、免疫治疗和重症监护领域的血浆来源及重组蛋白疗法。所审阅的披露内容侧重于现有产品的开发;未核实到符合简报纳入规则的资产。

watch.en: Plasma collection underpins the portfolio; management identifies recombinant FVIII as the exception to donor dependence.
watch.zh: 血浆采集是产品组合的基础;管理层指出重组 FVIII 是不依赖献血者的例外。

watch.en: Management highlights immunoglobulin infection prevention in CLL, but a submitted label-expansion application and decision date were not verified.
watch.zh: 管理层强调免疫球蛋白可预防 CLL 患者感染,但未核实是否已提交适应症扩展申请及决定日期。

watch.en: 2025 operating cash flow was EUR661 million, with EUR117 million of R&D and EUR331 million of capital expenditure.
watch.zh: 2025 年经营现金流为 EUR661 million,其中研发支出 EUR117 million,资本支出 EUR331 million。

watch.en: Management identifies the US as the main 2025 growth driver, particularly immunoglobulins, FVIII and four-factor PCC.
watch.zh: 管理层指出美国是 2025 年的主要增长动力,尤其是免疫球蛋白、FVIII 和四因子 PCC。

gaps: Zero items means no eligible asset was verified, not that Octapharma has no development pipeline. The R&D page lists Phase IV GENA studies, which are excluded.

Approved-product indication research without a verified regulatory filing is excluded under the brief. In particular, the shareholder review describes expected immunoglobulin label expansion in CLL without establishing a submission or review date.
A current asset-level list of unapproved clinical candidates and published phase-by-phase counts were not found; counts is null.

The latest group financial review located covers 2025 and was published February 17, 2026, before 2026-06; a newer quarterly or half-year group results release was not located. The R&D page is undated.

Required curl HEAD checks were attempted for every cited URL. All failed with DNS resolution errors (curl exit 6; HTTP 000) in this environment. Sources were opened through the web browsing tool, but independent curl status verification could not be completed.
